picks.headline: Anthropic Activates ASL-3 Protections for Claude Opus 4 Release
picks.why: Anthropic has provisionally triggered its AI Safety Level 3 security standard to mitigate chemical and biological risk factors ahead of releasing Claude Opus 4.
picks.title: Activating AI Safety Level 3 protections

picks.headline: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet for Agent-Driven Purchases
picks.why: The new feature allows AI agents operating across ChatGPT Work and Codex to execute transactions directly under explicit user confirmation.
picks.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet

picks.headline: Commodity 4B Decision Model Harness Uncovers 187 Real-World C/C++ Vulnerabilities
picks.why: Demonstrates that fine-tuned 4B open models on consumer GPUs can perform large-scale automated vulnerability discovery without frontier LLM API costs.
picks.title: Look Here, Then Decide: Small Decision Models in a Harness Find Memory-Safety Vulnerabilities at Scale on Commodity GPUs

picks.headline: Recurrent Inference State Leaks System Prompts and Private Context
picks.why: Exposes security flaws in persistent multi-turn LLM inference where context preserved in recurrent state can be extracted via state-probing and side-channel attacks.
picks.title: Privacy Leakage from Recurrent State in LLM Inference

picks.headline: AWS Upgrades AgentCore Runtime with MicroVM Snapshots for Fast Cold Starts
picks.why: Transitioning to Firecracker MicroVM snapshot restores cuts agent startup times by up to 15x while quadrupling compute density.
picks.title: Run agents securely and efficiently with the next generation AgentCore runtime

picks.headline: NVIDIA Details Multi-Node GLM-5.3 Serving via vLLM and ConnectX-8
picks.why: Offers an architecture blueprint for serving multi-node NVFP4-quantized massive models across DGX stations using RDMA tensor parallelism.
picks.title: When One GPU Isn’t Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM

papers.headline: Joint Early Vision Training Eliminates Need for Pretrained Vision Encoders
papers.why: Proves that dedicated in-fusion vision layers trained jointly from scratch outperform standard frozen pretrained vision backbones in multimodal LLMs.
papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding

papers.headline: Hybrid Decision Models Dynamically Route Between Single Pass and Deep Reasoning
papers.why: Introduces a zero-or-T self-routing layer that spends compute on extended token generation only when estimated utility justifies the cost.
papers.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models

papers.headline: FOAM Optimizer Halves SOAP Memory Footprint for Scalable Training
papers.why: Uses input-only preconditioning to match SOAP optimization performance while halving optimizer state memory requirements.
papers.title: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
